description: Opening documents whose parts the TS core reads leniently, read the same way: dual-colour stroke sides in any CSS colour (named, rgb(), hsl(), oklab(), oklch(), color()) normalised to hex; saved wet and paint events kept verbatim (extra fields, a non-integer at, integers past 64 bits, data that is not an object); culture tips with fields that are not numbers kept as NaN (saved as null); saved channel rects (light, fluor, thermo, layerChannels, ferro) read unchecked (missing, null, boolean, fractional and text coordinates, rects that are not objects); deep 16- and 32-bit pixels and masks decoded and saved again, with unreadable samples reported; pixel-layer effect generators kept; and image editor smart objects, unknown adjustment kinds and annotation layers without an annotation reported as the image editor reports them. The result saves and reopens cleanly.
